source: ERFA, derived from the IAU SOFA epv00 algorithm
procedure: The UTC instant was converted to a two-part TT Julian date and evaluated with eraEpv00. The stored heliocentric Earth position and velocity are the ERFA ph and vh outputs.
timeScale: UTC input converted to TT; EPV00 uses TDB approximated by TT
frame: BCRS-compatible equatorial J2000 orientation used by ERFA EPV00
accuracy: Values rounded to ten decimal places from ERFA double-precision output
